items.title: 从多鱼眼感知到全景感知：面向超低空无人机的视差感知机载平台
items.originalTitle: From Multi-Fisheye Sensing to Panoramic Perception: A Parallax-Aware Onboard Platform for Ultra-Low-Altitude UAVs
items.summary: 超低空无人机需要周围视野，该平台将四路同步鱼眼流转换为开放的1280x640等距柱状全景接口，通过逐重叠投影深度选择、受控接缝与光度融合形成全景，并部署精度与实时模式。评估使用超过50,000组四视角数据，精度模式远场P90特征错位降低41.6%，部署模式在16.7ms内运行，八扇区采样达到90.8%白天视觉地点识别Recall@5。
items.abstract: Ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) require surround vision near buildings, vegetation, and other obstacles. We present a parallax-aware onboard platform that converts four synchronized fisheye streams into an open 1280x640 equirectangular panorama (ERP) interface. A purpose-built carbon-fiber airframe integrates the cameras, NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, a flight controller, and a global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receiver. The formation pipeline selects projection depth per overlap and combines c…
keyFacts: 如何为超低空无人机实现紧凑、实时且视差感知的全景感知架构？
搭建集成四鱼眼相机、NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX、飞控与GNSS的碳纤维机载平台；形成流程按重叠选择投影深度并融合接缝；精度模式含内容自适应接缝搜索与验证门控残差网格；部署模式采用边距门控逐接缝更新。
精度模式使远场P90特征错位降低41.6%；部署模式在20Hz回放下达到19.99帧/秒，平均模块输入功耗13.29W；八扇区ERP采样在白天视觉地点识别中达到90.8%的Recall@5。

items.title: Cliff：从首次错误中学习过程奖励
items.originalTitle: Cliff: Learning Process Rewards from the First Mistake
items.summary: 针对RLVR依赖粗粒度结果奖励的问题，提出Cliff奖励塑形策略，利用现成LLM教师定位每次推演的首个错误，将推演分解为正确前缀与错误后缀，并赋予前缀正优势、后缀负反馈。在12个场景中，Cliff持续提升推理性能，超越on-policy蒸馏15%、GRPO 7%，即使教师能力有限。
items.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training, but its reliance on coarse outcome rewards leads to limited guidance on intermediate reasoning processes. Existing approaches such as process reward modeling and on-policy distillation introduce additional constraints, such as reliance on a specialized reward model or assuming identical reasoning patterns between teacher and student. Nevertheless, we observe that once a reasoning p…
keyFacts: 如何利用推理过程中的首次错误提供更细粒度的奖励信号以改善RLVR训练？
使用现成LLM教师识别每个推演中的首个错误，将推演分为前缀和后缀，并将此信号转化为token级优势：前缀赋正优势，后缀赋负优势。
在12个不同场景中，Cliff一致优于标准GRPO（提升7%）和on-policy蒸馏（提升15%），即使教师能力有限也有效。

items.title: CodePoisonRAG：检索增强代码生成中的知识投毒攻击
items.originalTitle: CodePoisonRAG: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
items.summary: 提出针对检索增强代码生成的上游知识投毒框架，通过CWE特定漏洞注入与语义误标，将良性修复代码转为毒化工件。黑盒攻击者在85个工件中实现0.7%语料投毒率，所有工件在Top-3内，攻击成功率0.80-0.93，对CodeGuarder仍达0.40-0.71，表明可主动传播特定弱点。
items.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation (RACG) improves LLM-based software development by retrieving external code artifacts, documentation, and patches, and incorporating them into the generation context. This reliance on external knowledge introduces a critical trust boundary: poisoned artifacts can influence generated code without modifying the underlying LLM. Prior work shows that selecting existing vulnerable examples can increase the general vulnerability rate of RACG outputs, but leaves open whether a black-box…
keyFacts: 黑盒攻击者能否构造单一任务匹配的恶意工件，向检索增强代码生成传播特定弱点？
构造毒化工件：CWE特定漏洞注入（嵌入源到汇流）与语义误标（添加虚假安全声明），攻击者对知识库、检索器等不可访问，对每预期任务最多注入一个工件，覆盖10个CWE。
85个毒化工件全部出现在对应查询的Top-3结果中，攻击成功率在0.80–0.93之间；对CodeGuarder防御仍保持0.40–0.71的成功率，表明攻击超出偶然传播。

items.abstract: Signal Phase and Timing (SPaT) messages are a cornerstone of connected vehicle (CV) safety, enabling CVs to perceive and respond to intersection state through Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I) and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. The integrity of these messages is threatened by a range of application-layer attacks that can bypass conventional authentication when a roadside unit or peer vehicle is compromised. Existing intrusion detection research either defends the infrastructure side or targets V2V Basic Saf…
keyFacts: 如何从车载视角检测针对SPaT消息的应用层攻击，并填补该研究空白？
生成模拟数据集SPADE：基于Eclipse MOSAIC在SAE J2735应用层运行时攻击注入，含六种攻击与良性类别；组合四种路口几何、六种操作条件、五次随机重复，生成180个场景并提取融合特征。
SPADE包含180个场景、约1,890,000条带标签记录（每类270,000），每记录40个特征，并公开数据集与代码库。

items.abstract: Interview assessment requires per-criterion judgments grounded in behavioral evidence, yet surging applicant volumes have made human-only evaluation costly and inconsistent, while existing AI approaches yield opaque scores without traceable rationale. We introduce PhoenixNest-Video, an evidence-grounded multimodal agent framework for automated video interview assessment. It builds a semantic video graph as structured working memory, performs rubric-conditioned retrieval with cross-modal verification across visual…
keyFacts: 如何构建自动化视频面试评估框架，以提供基于证据的逐标准判断并保持可解释性？
构建语义视频图作为结构化工作记忆；执行基于规则的检索与跨模态验证；训练基于Rubrics的强化学习评分器，包含双奖励（规则对齐和分数差异化）。

items.originalTitle: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
items.summary: 本文提出TRACE框架，确保自主机器人每个行动都能通过文档化因果链追溯至传感器证据。框架分为语义感知、信念推理、行动合成和执行验证四个可审计层，模型无关且集成学习感知模块。在仓库机器人导航实验中使用三个客观指标评估，TRACE在500个模拟决策周期中实现了98.6%的证据可追溯性、99.0%的时间连续性和98.1%的决策可重构性，满足EU AI法案要求。

The framework organizes decision-making into four auditable layers: Semantic Perception for evidence-grounded entity reco…

items.originalTitle: The Implications of Linguistic Illegibility for LLM Security
items.summary: 本文提出“语言不可读性”概念，指LLM外部化或机制探测的语言伪影无法代表模型实际思考的场景。认为对于内部计算基于激活空间数学的LLM，这种不可读性不可避免。因此依赖语言自我报告的安全机制无法完全可靠，需要隔离技术。建议采用taint跟踪观察输出，并讨论其他沙箱机制，以提供语言监控之外的保障。
items.abstract: LLMs are trained to generate natural language. However, various strands of evidence indicate that an LLM's externalized linguistic outputs and mechanistically-extracted linguistic features can be an unreliable lens for understanding internal model computation. We introduce the term ``linguistic illegibility'' to broadly refer to scenarios in which an LLM's externalized or mechanistically-probed language artifacts fail to represent how the model actually thinks. We argue that the specter of linguistic illegibility…
keyFacts: LLM的语言输出不可靠时，安全机制如何保证？
概念论证，分析现有安全机制漏洞，提议taint跟踪和沙箱机制。
语言不可读性不可避免，安全机制需不依赖语言状态；taint跟踪有前景。

items.originalTitle: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions
items.summary: 本文提出一个端到端专业化流水线，结合大规模问题策展、合成推理轨迹、监督微调和强化学习。使用22,000个问题训练Nemotron模型并引入GenCorrect测试时计算策略。在IOI 2025上，Nano-CC从130分提升至468分，超金牌线；Ultra-CC达502分。在IOI 2026前瞻性评估中，系统得分535.4超金牌线，首次超过人类最高分。

items.summary: 提出HINT框架，受人类操控原理启发，仅在模式转换时调用语义推理，并通过多视图锚定和视觉跟踪维持承诺，利用图像空间语义高亮和注意力先验注入两种视觉接口与动作策略通信。实验表明能显著提升意图理解、任务进度和端到端成功率。
items.abstract: Humans can perform complex manipulations given a simple intent through an overall instruction, while continuously adapting to evolving visual observations. However, current vision-language action (VLA) models and other action policies struggle to realize this high-level intelligent behavior under dense, evolving visual inputs and sparse language guidance. Visual correlations can then dominate semantic intent, leading actions to follow visual shortcuts rather than human goals. We present HINT (Human-INTent INcepTio…

items.title: 量子计算的最优融合策略
items.originalTitle: Optimal Fusion Strategies for Quantum Computation
items.summary: 逻辑融合在量子信息中很重要，如量子纠错和量子中继器。光子设置中物理融合具有概率性，故障基础的选择称为融合策略。当k=1个量子比特编码时，我们提供了完整表征，并刻画了完美融合策略的码与策略，恢复了已知结果并为量子奇偶校验码找到完美融合策略，且证明随机图码以指数接近1的概率具有完美融合策略。同时赋予新图参数操作意义。
items.abstract: Logical fusions are important for a number of tasks in quantum information, such as quantum error correction and quantum repeaters. In the photonic setting one must contend with the fact that physical fusions are probabilistic (i.e.~the associated qubits are measured in product bases), which---depending on the failures and the associated bases---can lead to a failure on the logical level. The choice of failure basis of each qubit is known as a fusion strategy, and finding good fusion strategies is important for op…

完整表征编码单个量子比特的码和融合策略，引入完美融合策略概念，并分析随机图码的完美融合策略概率。

To address this gap, we first distinguish strict zero-shot transfer…

items.summary: 提出基于物理的自适应Koopman MPC策略，用于惯性不确定性和主动目标机动下的组合航天器姿态稳定。从四元数运动学构造新型四元数Koopman模型，比黑盒EDMD更紧凑可解释。采用梯度下降更新律识别时变惯性，MPC简化为QP，降低计算负担。正式建立递归可行性和区域输入状态稳定性。高保真3D仿真验证有效性。

A novel, quaternion-based Koopman model is constructed from a set of analytical lifting functions derived from the quaternion kinematics, which provides a more compact and physically interpretable linear representation of the nonlinear dynamics compared with the conventional black-box EDMD and higher-dimensional DC…

items.title: QMA(2)与QMA之间的量子神谕分离
items.originalTitle: A quantum oracle separation between QMA(2) and QMA
items.summary: 我们找到了一个量子神谕，使得QMA与QMA(2)不相等。作为推论，我们解决了Watrous的不可去纠缠猜想：对于每一个ε+δ<1，任何(ε,δ)-去纠缠器所需的输入大小都随输出量子比特数的指数增长而增长。
items.abstract: We find a quantum oracle relative to which $\mathsf{QMA} \neq \mathsf{QMA}(2)$. As a consequence, we resolve the no-disentanglers conjecture of Watrous: for every $ε+δ<1$, any $(ε,δ)$-disentangler requires input size exponential in the number of output qubits. Our proof combines the unitarily invariant polynomial method of She and Yuen (ITCS '23) with a new construction based on the symmetric and antisymmetric subspace projectors, reducing the $\mathsf{QMA}$ lower bound to the approximate degree of $\mathrm{OR}$.

结合She和Yuen (ITCS '23)的酉不变多项式方法与基于对称和反对称子空间投影子构造，将QMA下界归约到OR的近似度。
存在量子神谕使得QMA≠QMA(2)，并解决了Watrous的不可去纠缠猜想。

冷却导致输运损失，含EMC电解质更严重；EC基系统中低FEC浓度（0-2%）具有相当的低温输运，高FEC（5-10%）在233 K时电导率保持较低；配位主要由溶剂主导。
